gaps.sentence: He behaves as if he were ___ owner of the company.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — there is one owner, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: ___ Galapagos Islands are famous for unique wildlife.
gaps.explanation: Groups of islands take 'the': the Galapagos Islands, the Canary Islands.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best meal I've ever had.
___ poverty remains a serious issue worldwide.
The thief was sent to ___ prison for three years.
gaps.explanation: 'Sent to prison' — the institution, no article; 'the prison' would mean the building.

gaps.sentence: He was born in ___ Netherlands, not in Belgium.
gaps.explanation: Country names that are plural or contain 'Kingdom/Republic/States' take 'the': the Netherlands.

gaps.sentence: They moved to ___ coastal town an hour south of the capital.
gaps.explanation: A coastal town — first mention of one of many.

gaps.sentence: I only need ___ few more minutes to finish.
gaps.explanation: 'A few minutes' = some minutes; 'few' alone would mean almost none.
